Cozy, charming, delicious and affordable.
Mar 2026 • Family
This restaurant is located in a cozy street and immediately feels warm and homely. Don’t expect luxury, but a cosy, almost primitive charm that makes it extra special. The food is surprisingly tasty and affordable. The service is friendly and personal; Tam even gave us tips for the best local addresses. And even did such a sweet little errand for me.

The photos of guests on the wall top it all off — like joining friends. A place where you leave with a smile.
